title: timer invisible armor
description: allows making individual pieces of armor invisible using the smithing table.
body:
**allows making individual pieces of armor invisible using the smithing table.**

---

• combining a piece of armor with an **amethyst shard** will make it render **invisible** on the player.

• combining an invisible piece of armor with **glow berries** will make it **visible** again.

**works for all player armor (head/chest/legs/feet pieces) as well as: horse armor, wolf armor, nautilus armor, and saddles.**

---
